commands.name: tier histogram
commands.argv: awk -F'|' '/^\|[[:space:]]*S[0-9][0-9][0-9]+[[:space:]]*\|/ {t=$5; gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",t); n[t]++} END{for(k in n) printf "%s=%d ", k, n[k]; print ""}' corpus/SOURCES.md

commands.name: status histogram
commands.argv: awk -F'|' '/^\|[[:space:]]*S[0-9][0-9][0-9]+[[:space:]]*\|/ {s=$9; gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",s); n[s]++} END{for(k in n) printf "%s=%d ", k, n[k]; print ""}' corpus/SOURCES.md

commands.name: duplicate ids
commands.argv: awk -F'|' '/^\|[[:space:]]*S[0-9][0-9][0-9]+[[:space:]]*\|/ {i=$2; gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",i); print i}' corpus/SOURCES.md | sort | uniq -d

commands.name: enum violations and tier inflation
commands.argv: awk -F'|' '/^\|[[:space:]]*S[0-9][0-9][0-9]+[[:space:]]*\|/ && NF==13 {i=$2;k=$4;t=$5;s=$9; gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",i); gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",k); gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",t); gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",s); if (t !~ /^[ABC]$/) print "tier", i, t; if (s !~ /^(queued|mined|rejected)$/) print "status", i, s; if (k !~ /^(spec|docs|paper|code|tool|dataset|talk|book|community|own-work)$/) print "kind", i, k; if (t=="A" && k=="community") print "tier-inflation", i}' corpus/SOURCES.md

commands.name: mined rows whose used-by paths do not exist
commands.argv: awk -F'|' '/^\|[[:space:]]*S[0-9][0-9][0-9]+[[:space:]]*\|/ && NF==13 {s=$9; gsub(/[[:space:]]/,"",s); if (s=="mined") {n=split($12, a, /[,;]/); for (j=1;j<=n;j++) {p=a[j]; gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/,"",p); if (p!="" && p!="—") print p}}}' corpus/SOURCES.md | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || echo "missing: $p"; done
